resources.string: Ivumela i-Mareco ukurekhoda ukuthinta nokuswayipha kwakho, kwaye iziphinde ngawe. Yenza kuphela izenzo ozirekhodileyo, ayikwazi ukufunda into esikrinini sakho, kwaye i-app ayinakufikelela kwi-intanethi.

Yimile: i-Android ayivumanga izenzo. Hlola ukuba inkonzo yokufikeleleka ivuliwe.

Akukho nto yokuqhuba: i-macro ayinakuthinta okanye kuswayipha.
“%s” iphinda ngonaphakade. Yiyima nanini na ngeqhosha eliluhlaza ■ kwibha entantayo, ngeqhosha le-STOP kwi-app, okanye ngokucinezela i-Volume Up kunye ne-Volume Down ngaxeshanye.
Irekhodwe ngemo ye-%1$s kodwa iskrini ngoku ngemo ye-%2$s. Jika ifowuni ibuyele umva okanye ukuthinta kuya kufika kwiindawo ezingalunganga.
Irekhodwe kwiskrini ye-%1$s. Iskrini yangoku: %2$s. Iindawo ziya kulinganiswa, ngoko vavanya ngaphambi kokuyishiya ngaphandle komntu.
Ubume beskrini buhlukile, ngoko ukuthinta okulinganisiweyo kunokuphambuka kancinci.
I-Android ivumela i-app kuphela ukuthinta nokuswayipha endaweni yakho ngezicwangciso zokufikeleleka. Ithatha malunga nomzuzu kwaye icacisiwe ngenyathelo ngenyathelo.
Iqala inkonzo yokufikeleleka… Ukuba oku kuhlala, vula ulungiselelo.
Rekhoda i-macro yakho yokuqala ukuze uqale.
Ibha entantayo iyavela. Vula umdlalo wakho, emva koko cinezela ● ukuze uqale.
Ibha encinci esebenzisa phezu komdlalo wakho.
Ulungele. Vula izilawuli ezintantayo, uze utshintshele kumdlalo wakho.
Ilindele i-Android ukuyiqala… cinezela iqhosha elingezantsi kungekudala.

1. Cinezela iqhosha elingezantsi.
2. Vula “Izicelo ezifakiweyo” okanye “Izicelo ezikhuphelweyo”.
3. Khetha Mareco uze uyivule.
4. Buya apha.

Inkonzo yokufikeleleka: yeyona ndlela i-Android evumela ngayo i-app ukuba ikuthinte iswayiphe. I-Mareco iyisebenzisa ukuzoba izilawuli ezintantayo, ukubeka isigaba esingabonakaliyo kwiskrini xa urekhoda, kunye nokuphinda izenzo zakho. I-Mareco ayikwazi ukufunda iskrini yakho, iipassword zakho okanye imiyalezo yakho.

Ukucinezela iqhosha: kuphela xa urekhoda okanye uqhuba, ukuze i-Mareco irekhode i-Back / Home / Recents kwaye iqaphele ukuyima kwesiphango ngokucinezela i-Volume Up kunye ne-Volume Down. Umbhalo obhaliweyo awugcinwa ngaliphi na ixesha.
Yeyiphi i-app phambili: isetyenziselwa kuphela ukhuseleko olukhethwayo “Qhuba kuphela xa le app ivulekile”.
I-Mareco ayinayo imvume yeintanethi nkqu, ngoko akukho nto inokuphuma kwifowuni yakho.

I-Android 13 nakwezintsha ithintela ii-app ezifakwe ngaphandle kwe-Play Store ukusebenzisa ukufikeleleka, de uvume:
1. Cinezela “Vula ulwazi lwe-app”.
2. Cinezela amachaphaza amathathu asekunene phezulu.
3. Khetha “Vumela izicwangciso ezithintelweyo” uze uqinisekise.
4. Buyela umva uze uvule inkonzo.
Kwiiseshoni ezinde beka ukusetyenziswa kwebhetri ye-Mareco ibe “Akukho kuthintelwa” (Ulwazi lwe-app → Ibhetri) kwaye ugcine ichaja iqhagamshelwe. Xa i-macro iqhuba, i-Mareco igcina iskrini ivuliwe.

Iqhosha eliluhlaza ● / ▶: liqala ukurekhoda (imodi REC) okanye liqhuba i-macro yakho (imodi RUN). Xa urekhoda okanye uqhuba, liba ■: cinezela ukuze uyime. Emva kokurekhoda ibuza ukuba uyinike igama uze uyigcine.
Bamba iqhosha eliluhlaza: misa okanye uqhubeke (xa urekhoda okanye uqhuba), okanye uyime (xa imisiwe).
Gear: khetha imodi yokurekhoda (Rekhoda i-macro) okanye imodi yokuqala (Qala i-macro), khetha i-macro yakho esisiseko, utshintshe izicwangciso zokuqhuba kunye nazo zonke ezinye izicwangciso.
Iiarrow ezine: hudula ibha nakweyiphi na indawo. X: vala ibha (yivule kwakhona kwi-app). Cinezela ixesha elide iqhosha ukubona igama lalo.

1. Kwi-Mareco, cinezela Qala ukurekhoda. Ibha entantayo iyavela.
2. Vula umdlalo wakho.
3. Cinezela iqhosha eliluhlaza ● xa ulungele.
4. Yenza izenzo zakho ngokuqhelekileyo.
5. Cinezela ■ uze unike i-macro igama.
6. Gear → Qala i-macro, lungisa izicwangciso zokuqhuba uze ucinezele ▶.
Yima nanini na ngeqhosha ■, ngeqhosha le-STOP kwi-app, okanye ngokucinezela i-Volume Up kunye ne-Volume Down ngaxeshanye.
Live (okuzenzekelayo): I-Mareco irekhoda ukuthinta kwakho kwaye iphinde isenzo ngasinye kwi-app kwangoko xa uphakamisa umnwe, ukuze umdlalo usabele xa urekhoda.
Plan: ukuthinta kurekhodwa kuphela; i-app ayisabeli. Sebenzisa oku ukuba i-Live ibangela iingxaki.

• I-app ayikwazi ukujonga ukuthinta okuya kwenye i-app. Yiyo lento ukurekhoda kusebenzisa isigaba esicacileyo kwaye kuphinda izenzo zakho. Ukuthinta okutsha ngomzuzwana omncinci xa isenzo siphindwa kunokungabonwa, ngoko phepha ukucinezela ngokukhawuleza okuphindaphindwayo xa urekhoda, okanye sebenzisa imodi ye-Plan.
• Ezinye iiskrini zithintela izenzo ezizenzekelayo: iindawo zepassword, ii-app zebhanki kunye nezo ii-app zithintela izixhobo zokufikeleleka.
• Kuphela i-Back, i-Home kunye ne-Recents ezinokurekhodwa njengokucinezela iqhosha. I-Volume, ikhamera kunye nezinye iqhosha azinakuphindwa.
• Akukho nto eqhubayo xa isikrini sicimile okanye sikhiyiwe. I-Mareco igcina isikrini sivuliwe ngexesha le-macro kwaye iyayeka xa sicima.
• Rekhoda kwaye uphinde kwindlela efanayo yesikrini. Ukuba ubungakanani besikrini buyahluka, i-Mareco iyazilinganisa iindawo zokuthinta kwaye iyakulumkisa.
• I-Android inokuyeka ii-app ezisemva ukugcina ibhetri. Seta ukusetyenziswa kwebhetri ye-Mareco kube “Akukho zithintelo” kwiiseshoni ezinde.
I-Mareco ayinamvume yokufikelela kwi-intanethi. Ii-macro ziifayile ze-.mareco ezigcinwe ngasese kwifowuni yakho; wena ukhetha ngexesha lokuzabelana nazo.

Cinezela onke amaqhosha avolumu ngaxeshanye ukuze uyeke i-macro eqhutywayo kwangoko.

Mareco %s\nIsimahla, akukho zintengiso, akukho kufikelela kwi-intanethi. Ii-macro zakho zihlala kule fowuni njengeefayile ze-.mareco.

Imodi yokurekhoda i-macro: cinezela iqhosha eliluhlaza ●, yenza izenzo zakho kwi-app, emva koko cinezela iqhosha eliluhlaza ■ ukugqiba. Uya kucelwa igama, njengakwisixhobo sokurekhoda izenzo se-emulator.
Imodi “Qala i-macro” iqhuba i-macro egciniweyo. Awukakhethi nayiphi i-macro okwangoku: tshintsha uye kwimodi yokurekhoda i-macro uze urekhode enye, okanye ukhethe enye ekhoyo.
I-macro eqhelekileyo (tshintsha izicwangciso zayo, uze ucinezele ukudlala):
Cofa igama ukuze libe yi-macro eqhelekileyo. Cofa iqhosha eliluhlaza lokudlala ukuze uyiqhube ngoku.

Cofa Kopisha (okanye Yabelana) uze uthumele esi sicatshulwa kumphuhlisi. Sichaza ngokucacileyo into engalunganga.
